entries.3f6c45e41c8075b5: The center of sales is the interior and exterior products-related business, and its net sales to external customers of ¥35,944 million in the fiscal year ended December 2025 account for about 84% of consolidated net sales. This is followed by the speed reducer-related business at ¥3,602 million and the parking equipment-related business at ¥3,076 million. By region, net sales to external customers in Japan exceed 90% of consolidated net sales, and most are domestic. entries.5373425e46facc78: The company has formulated its medium-term management plan Tachikawa Vision 2028 — Creating Comfortable Living — covering the 3 years from fiscal 2026, and states that, as a manufacturer, it will focus on "manufacturing and market creation," "investment for growth" and "social contribution." In the interior and exterior products-related business, it states that it will advance expanding sales of value-added products such as light-control fabric products, for which demand is expected to expand, electric products and panel partitions, advance development at its technology research building, use of the Shinjuku showroom it opened in January 2026, and capturing renovation demand through M&A and alliances in new business areas. In the speed reducer-related business, it states that it will expand sales of the servo motor business it took over in January 2024 and strengthen set sales with speed reducers. In the parking equipment-related business, it states that it will focus on promoting the wide range of specifications of Puzzle Tower, promoting mutual sales alliances, and acquiring orders for renovation and repair projects.
